# root-listing

the node root: the listing every walk starts from

- Captured from the FusioN6 at 10.6.40.53 on 2026-09-24, firmware `0x68cd783f`.
- Request: `GET /emsfp/node/v1/`
- `wire.jsonl` — the exchange as it went out and came back (ADR-0028 capture records).
- `body.txt` — the response body alone, which is what the decoder reads.
